name: Spi-1 proto-oncogene

function.text: SPI1 encodes transcription factor PU.1. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription activator activity and DNA-binding transcription factor activity. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and transcription initiation-coupled chromatin remodeling.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to agammaglobulinemia 10, autosomal dominant (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports rearrangement context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.

function.text: SPI1 encodes transcription factor PU.1. Based in part on similarity, FCER1A transactivation is achieved in cooperation with GATA1.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with agammaglobulinemia 10, autosomal dominant (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SPI1 have been reported in t-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma.
